data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Dafiyyah means 'the one who heals'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'dafaa' which means 'to heal'. It is also related to the Arabic word 'dafa' which means 'to protect'. In Islamic tradition, Dafiyyah symbolizes the healing and protection that comes from Allah. The name dafiyah carries the meaning “Healing, protection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose dafiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody healing, protection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
